title: Amazing Staff and good variety of fresh delicious food
text:
Visited for 3 nights and enjoyed breakfast, lunch and dinner here each day. 
A great variety to choose from - seafood, Indonesian and western choices. The seafood bbq buffet on the Saturday night was the highlight. 
Staff very friendly and attentive. The food was made to order and very fresh and tasty. Made the trip that much better.

title: A beautiful place to Chill
text: CBC is a great place to relax and chill away from the hustle and bustle of Jakarta. For surfers, it's paradise with an awesome surf break right off the shore. For non-surfers the food is delicious, the views are soothing and the cool breeze in the restaurant makes it a great place to relax, read a book, work or play games with friends. We really enjoyed playing with our son in the pool surrounded by greenery and walking 10 minutes over to the beach nearby to look at the seashells and play in the tidal pools.

title: peaceful and beautiful getaway from Jakarta for everyone
text: As a family we have been been back to Cimaja Beach Club many times over the last few months , each and every trip has been enjoyable for everyone in the family. The owners, staff and dogs make everyone so welcome. The food is always fantastic ,it never disappoints . It is both peaceful and charming . The area itself has many sandy beaches nearby and plenty of surf options . Cimaja Beach Club is special and a very safe place to be during this challenging year.

title: Amazing place!
text:
Me and my boyfriend stayed at CBC for 3 days and 2 nights, from Thursday to Saturday. 

We booked the transportation service from CBC since I figured it would be easier than doing it myself, which turned out excellent. The road were really steep to CBC and it was kind of hidden. The driver was an excellent driver! It was a smooth drive to Cimaja and to Jakarta. I suggested if you've never been there and unfamiliar with the area, it's better to book their car service since the road is a bit dangerous. The price is also almost similar if you rent your own car. 

When we got there, we were amazed by the pebble beach, it was wonderful. Then we saw hidden gem, Cimaja Beach Club! We stayed in the standard bungalow for two people. It was minimalistic, clean and comfortable. The highlight of the bungalow is rooftop deck! It was amazing! I think we spent more time on rooftop deck than the beach. 

The bungalow has air conditioner, towels, trash can, dresser, hot and cold shower. They don't provide amenities like soap, shampoo, toothbrush, toothpaste, and kettle for coffee and tea. So make sure to bring your own or you can just go to indomaret or alfamart nearby. 

Their food is amazing! I was totally blown away by their food. It was very delicious! We only ate at their restaurant since we were a bit lazy. The room rate included breakfast. I recommend the english breakfast! The food is a bit pricey but actually the same price as restaurants in Jakarta and it was totally worth it. 

Their restaurant area also a great place to chill, sitting on the bean bags and enjoying the view of paddy rice on sunset. 

Their service is amazing! All of the staffs are really helpful, very friendly and smiling everytime. We love the dogs too. I am so sorry to hear about Trooper. We loved him dearly, he used to lay under the table when we had meals and followed me to our room and gave us love. 

If you're looking for a quite place with amazing view and a place to surf. This is it! In this place you can enjoy both sceneries, on your right side is paddy rice and your left side is the beach! Complete set!!

title: Sounds of traditional Indonesia
text: I have had the distinct pleasure in getting to know the owner Jez, his wife Tessa, and their 4 or 5 dogs over the past 5 years, I have seen the growth of Cimaja Beach Club from its initial days of planning, to what it has become--a true treasure of West Java. If you desire to play in the ocean, watch traditional rice cultivation, eat a variety of excellent cuisines prepared by an all-star staff, or just relaxing on the second story while gazing at the palms gently swaying in the Indonesian breeze, then this is the place for you. Even though there is a bit of a walk to get to the accommodations, every step is worth the journey.

title: Amazing food - worth the adventure to get there
text: A gem of a restaurant perched above the ride padi fields, right on the Cimaja beach break. We went with a large family group of varied ages and thought the rocky path walk from Cimaja beach parking a bit dodgy in the dark... but then completely worthwhile once we sat down to eat. Every single dish we ordered was excellent - the best sate sauce I've tasted yet in Indonesia, all the way to the decadent brownie dessert finish. It was so darn good that we went back for breakfast the next day, and were equally impressed with the food. The view is gorgeous, the staff super friendly and helpful (terima kasih Ibu Nuri!) -- all in all, really wonderful.  As another reviewer stated, too bad if word gets out about this hidden gem in Cimaja!

title: Hidden Little Paradise
text:
Went here 2 times. The first time i came in here was just with the missus. Loved it so much, i booked the whole place and brought 11 friends with me the next visit.

Everyone have nothing but high praise for the place, the food is excellent (especially the Saturday Seafood BBQ), the view from the hotel is beautiful, a perfect retreat to nature.

The staff is very polite, the host Jez is also very helpful, sending his staff to help us when necessary and giving us beach recommendations.

If there’s one complaint in this review, it is that by writing this review, more people will know about this little hidden paradise, which means more people to compete with when trying to book this place 😅. Can’t wait for our next visit!!!!

title: Awful access to the resort and noisy
text:
The place has the prettiest and hip interior style-wise. It also has a newly built restaurant. Their main attraction seems to be the roofs for each rooms. But that's it.

The access to the resort is pretty difficult if you arrive at night as you have to walk through stones for about 500-750 meters. No lighting whatsoever, not even a torch or a way finding signs.

Since the accommodation is located right in front of the Cimaja break, makes sleeping at night to be troublesome due to the loud noises from the waves crashing.

Haven't been back there for some time. Would only come back if the other accommodations are full.

Cimaja Square for the win!
ownerResponse/text:
Hi Daniel,

Sorry you didn't have a good time at the resort. We do have lights 200m along the beach but they must have been switched off on the night in question so I will ask my security why this was the case. I've been waiting for the rest of the pathway to be lit up by the town council (as the beach is not owned by me) so I really have no idea how long this will take.

As for the sounds of the waves, there's not much I can do about that. Personally I think it's much better than listening to the sounds coming of the road, as with all the other resorts and homestays in Cimaja.

Anyway, feedback taken onboard. 

Cheers.

title: Amazing Place

I would visit the place for the food alone. They had a motorbike ready for us to explore waterfalls and beaches and also organized our car and driver from Jakarta. You don't need to be a surfer to enjoy some quality downtime at CBC. Thanks for the memorable time!

Die Küchencrew rund um Bayou, Erik und Lokman schaffen es kulinarisch jeden Tag neue Köstlichkeiten hervorzuzaubern.

title: Best place to stay in West Java
text: We arrived late at night due to traffic coming from Jakarta to find a quiet tranquil place amidst the rice paddies, right in front of the surf spot at Cimaja. We stayed for four nights (not nearly enough), eating dinner at the restaurant here every single night. The chefs are very talented, and on the last night (even though we were the only two people staying there), they made us a huge seafood BBQ dinner just for us with fish from the local market. The staff are all extremely friendly and accommodating. The beds and rooms are clean, modern, and very comfortable, and the sitting area next to the restaurant is great, with decent Wifi to boot. They have good quality surfboards to rent as well, so I didn't even need to bring my own board (the wave itself, a 60-second walk from the bedroom, also being amazing). Not much more to ask for on a trip - great food, great service, great rooms and great waves make for one of the best trips you can have in Indonesia. I'm already planning my next trip back to do it all over again.

text: Had a truly amazing weekend with two friends in the beach club. The host Jez and his wife are the most helpful people I have meet, they helped us arrange surf lessons and transportation to Jakarta among other things. Saturday evening there was a delicious barbecue and all the guests gathered around the big table and it was a great community feeling. I will defiantly be going back.

title: Already missing CBC
text:
Two friends and I spent three nights in Cimaja Beach Club. We all were stunned. The place is absolutely gorgeous.

The bungalow was clean and comfortable with AC and very clean bathroom. The sundeck on the top provided beautiful views over the rice fields and gave us an opportunity to marvel at the sunset. The beach is very close, and you can feel and hear the ocean at all times. Just perfect.

Every meal that Chef Jim prepared was extremely good (some of the best food I have had in Indonesia). The host Jez has to be one of the most caring hosts ever; he organized our transportation to Cimaja and our surf lessons on the spot, and took care of all our needs. You simply cannot ask for a better experience. This has to be it. :)

title: Surfen und entspannen im Cimaja Beach Club
text:
Insgesamt war ich für vier Wochen in cimaja und bin die ersten beiden Wochen in einem losmen in cimaja untergekommen. Der Lärmpegel von der Straße und der Moschee war allerdings irgendwann nicht mehr erträglich und ein Kollege erzählte mir vom cimaja beach club. Wenn man neu in cimaja ankommt ist es nicht sofort auffindbar, man muss die Straße bis zum cimaja point nehmen und dann rechts an den offenen Hütten vorbei und ein bisschen weiter bevor man dort ankommt. Die extra drei bis fünf Minuten Fußweg lohnen sich alle mal! Das komplette Gelände ist wunderschön und super gepflegt! Die Bungalows sind großzügig und besitzen eine Dachterrasse von der man eine geniale Aussicht über das Meer hat. Die Ruhe ist unbeschreiblich nachdem ich zwei Wochen nie entspannt schlafen konnte. Man ist direkt am point und wird durch das rauschen vom Meer in den Schlaf gewogen. Die Küche ist ebenfalls hervorragend und bietet sowohl eine lokale als auch internationale Gerichte an. Der Gemeinschaftsbereich ist wie der Rest ebenfalls super gemütlich und sehr einladend. Die Angestellten und der Besitzer "Jess" sind super freundlich und sehr hilfsbereit. Jess selber ist ein hervorragender Surfer und ein toller Gastgeber. 
Ich freue mich schon auf das nächste mal! Bis bald Cimaja Beach Club :)

title: Magnifique
text:
J'étais loge dans la rue principale qui est beaucoup trop bruyante. J'ai découvert cet endroit par chance en discutant avec le propriétaire, pendant une session de surf. L'endroit est sur la plage avec les rizières et montagnes en arrière plans (aucun moustiques), perdu au milieu de la nature luxuriante. C'est juste parfait, sans parler de la cuisine incroyable  de Jim qui as travaillé précédemment à Macao et Arabie Saoudite, ses plats sont incroyable.
Bref un endroit dans le monde a ne pas manquer.

title: Essential Jakarta Getaway
text: As a Jakarta dweller, the need to escape the grinding urban concrete jungle is essential for one's sanity. The Cimaja Beach Club is the perfect respite. Not only are you nestled right on the shore of some of West Java's most spectacular surf the bungalow's are superb and the chef's food needs to be tasted to be believed!! This place is a must!

title: Best place I've ever come across!
text: This place is more than perfect! Beautiful bungalows surrounded by rice fields and the beach, mesmerizing sunrises and sunsets, relaxed and cozy atmosphere, best surf spots and the most amazing host who takes care of all your needs! Words cannot do the beauty of this place justice...you have to experience it yourself!

title: This is Paradise!
text: After 5 weeks of travelling through Indonesia (Java, Lombok, Gili Meno, Kalimantan), this was by far the most beautiful and relaxing stay we've experienced. On the rooftop of the bungalows, sunrise and sunset with a stunning 360° view over the stony beach and rice fields can be admired while sitting on comfy deck chairs with a chilled drink. The surfer's spot of Cimaja is just in front of CBC and the beginners beach is only 15 minutes away by bike. The only sounds you can hear during the night are the waves splashig at the beach and the gekkos chatting to one another. Jez is the most caring host to imagine! He took us to the best local restaurants, brought us a bike, gave us his own surf board to borrow together with recommendations for the best surf spots and was always very forthcoming. We didn't wanna leave this place… We want to thank Jez for making our last days in Indonesia unforgettably perfect!

title: Amazing!

very quiet, between the rice field and the Ocean.

title: Top-notch hideaway haven
text:
Everything about place is right! It is exclusive, fun, personal, friendly and high quality.
Jim is a five star chef. Everything he serves is a surprise. Every lunch is started with a free salad and dinner is a full treat with a starter, main course, and dessert at an affordable price. 
The bungalow I stayed in is such a perfect nest. Intimate, very clean, very comfortable and just happy. The highlight is the 360 degree rooftop overlooking both sunrise and sunset. It is a spot to sunbath. Love it.
Surrounded by paddy field and the beach (with awesome waves, great for surfers) right at the entrance, you basically have the nature at the most.
Will definitely come as often as possible. Jez, is a great host too!

title: Makes me want to travel to Cimaja
text: I never stayed so close to the beach before. From the covered deck you can enjoy great meals and cold beers. It's the perfect holiday away from everything except for the waves breaking in front of you. There are two bungalows, with two more under construction. Each structure is constructed from re-purposed fishing boat timber, which adds an aesthetic appeal. The hosts are welcoming and very committed to an enjoyable stay for everyone, while also providing additional support organising transport, directions to local attractions as well as good surf information. A highlight of my stay was the food, which was prepared by an awesome chef who speaks English.

title: Pantainya mulai kotor
text:
Hallo~

Weekend kali ini saya berkesempatan mengunjungi Pantai Pelabuhan Ratu. Dari segi pantai, saya rasa sudah mulai kotor ya? Banyak sampah plastik hasil konsumsi pengunjung bertebaran di tepi pantai. Berjalan di tepi pantai tanpa alas kaki harus saya pikirkan dua kali karena kurang nyaman terasa. 

Terdapat beberapa cafe, resto dan penyedia kelapa muda segar di tepi pantai ini. Harga yang ditawarkan cukup relatif. title: What happen PL Ratu??
text:
Wow... Pelabuhan Ratu has drastically changed in the past 5 years. Very little attention to tourism and sadly to say, not many accommodations available that you can really wanna recommend. 

But on a positive note, if your making a day trip and wanna try some fresh seafood, there are dozen of places to choose from.  

I would definitely recommend the fish market in the center of town. You can hand pick the freshest catch of the day from fish, lobster etc. and pay “market price”, and have it cooked the way you like it - fried or grilled (for an additional fee).  Well worth trying.  

Other than that... the drive from Jakarta to Pelabuhan Ratu averages around 6 hours these days!  Google Maps shows it being Round 3.5 to 4 hours... but unfortunately that is not the case and I too travel twice a month here.  So prepare yourself. 

Hope my feedback is useful, and I don’t mean to be negative, but those who know and frequent Palabuhan Ratu over the years may relate to what I am saying ✌🏼

title: The closer to the market, the dirtier the beach
text:
PelabuhanRatu beach is one of beaches in Indonesia that associated with Nyi Roro Kidul. Nyi Loro Kidul (also spelled Nyai Roro Kidul, Rara Kidul) is a legendary Indonesian female spirit or deity, known as the Queen of the Southern Sea of Java (Indian Ocean or Samudra Kidul south of Java island) in Javanese and Sundanese mythology.

In my opinion PelabuhanRatu is dirty and not too beautiful beach. The closer to the market, the dirtier the beach :( 

It's okay to visit PelabuhanRatu beach if you want to, but don't expect too much about this beach or you'd disappointed. Personally, I don't recommend it for beach lover.

p.s. The better beach in PelabuhanRatu area in my opinion is KarangHawu beach (see my KarangHawu review on TripAdvisor if you wanna read it).

title: Pelabuhan Ratu o zachodzie słońca
text:
Wybralismy się do Pelabuhan Ratu samochodem z Jakarty , w dzień powszedni , żeby uniknąć korków . Wcześniej czytałam , że podróż z Jakarty samochodem może zająć nawet 12 godzin.  Nam przejazd w obie strony puls krótki pobyt , kolacja na plaży plus wieczorna wizyta na targu rybnym zajął 11 godzin.  Podróż samochodem i widoki po drodze to już niezapomniane wrażenia,  niespotykanie stroma szosa z dużą liczbą zakrętów , za oknem uprawy duriana , drzew kauczuko- 
wych , palmy z owoców której produkuje się olej . Wyjechaliśmy z Jakarty zaraz po południu a dotarliśmy na miejsce jeszcze za dnia ale już na krótko przed zachodem słońca. Plaża była praktycznie pusta , wynajęlismy podest z zadaszeniem za równowartość 3 $ us i zjedliśmy kolacje , prowiant zabraliśmy ze sobą , podziwiając uroki zachodzącego słońca na Oceanem Indyjskim. Wrażenia niezapomniane. 
Miejsce bezpieczne a mieszkający i pracujący przy  plaży miejscowi  życzliwi. 
O godz. 6 po południu byliśmy jedynymi w zasięgu wzroku turystami na tej plaży. 
Wynajęcie pokoju w hoteliku z widokiem na plażę to wydatek ca 500 tys. rupii za pokoj , dalej od plaży trochę taniej. My postanowiliśmy wracać nocą do Jakarty. 
Polecam też wizytę na targu rybnym , można zobaczyć i kupić  całe bogactwo darów oceanu , tunczyki , homary , kraby itd.
Do Jakarty udało się wrócić przed północą. 
Wspaniałe miejsce na wypoczynek a także na jednodniowy romantyczny wypad  z Jakarty.

title: Pantai dengan ombak besar

Di daerah pelabuhan ratu terdapat banyak pantai, ada yang private khusus untuk tamu penginapan dan ada juga yang untuk umum. Untuk sampai ke lokasi pantai, dijalan ada pungutan biaya untuk melewati jalan ke arah pantai. Jika tidak menginap di hotel yang ada pantainya, ada pantai umum yang bisa dikunjungi. Untuk masuk ke pantai ada biaya yang dikenakan per mobil bukan per orang. Ombak sangat besar sehingga tidak cocok untuk anak-anak kecil berenang, hanya bisa main pasir. Selesai berenang, ada kamar mandi untuk bersih-bersih, untuk menggunakan fasilitas ini juga ada tarifnya (murah saja). Kebetulan penginapan kami sudah ada pantainya, tapi pada saat itu kami juga berkunjung ke pantai umum untuk makan baso. 
Saran saya jika membawa keluarga dan punya uang lebih, lebih baik menyewa penginapan yang sekaligus ada pantainya karena waktu saya berkunjung ke pantai umum terdapat beberapa wanita yang berpakaian tidak layak untuk dilihat anak-anak.

Perjalanan yang cukup jauh - normal 4 jam via Bogor-Cibadak, membuat tempat ini menjadi kurang menarik. Tapi bagi para penikmat pantai, suasana yang dekat dengan alam dan jauh dari kebisingan kota, tempat ini menjadi sangat menarik. title: Great chill place to relax and have a holiday!
text:
Pelabuhan ratu is very nice to spend a holiday. There is not really much to do besides the beach (not swimmable in our opinion), pasar (inside and outside), fish market and some stores. But still very nice to escape the busy life in indonesia.

We stayed at augusta hotel, which has a pool so you can swim there instead of in the sea. Augusta hotel is very very very good!!! 

The pasar, outside, is really the most filthy one we have seen in all Java. The smell of rotten fish, stinky stuff and other smelly things is really really bad. The inside pasar on the other hand is a recommendation to everyone. It is organised, clean, hot tho (no airco) and you can buy everything you want for cheap. I wouldn't buy any jewelry here tho because the prices per gram are really expensive. In other places in Java it's cheaper. 

Although we only have been here for a couple of days, we really liked it and would have loved to stay longer. The vibe is really relaxed, the fish is so fresh and there is no such thing as horrible traffic in pelabuhan ratu. We will definitly come here again.

title: A great place to wind down
text: We love Pelabuhan Ratu, is a great place to wind down and relax. The beach is beautiful, we stayed near Karang Hawu- Cisolok. Some spots are not safe to swim but we love the sound of the wave hitting the rocks- So calming and the air is wonderful. Unfortunately, like many other beach destination in Indonesia, the government is not doing enough to make the beach trash-free. There are trash everywhere - some spots are so filthy full of trash. The government need to do something about the trash or else no one will come to Pelabuhan Ratu anymore- is a pity. Pretty beach full of trash.

title: Pantai Misteri Karang Hawu, Pelabuhan Ratu, Sukabumi
text:
Jawa Barat memiliki sejuta pesona wisata yang tak kalah menarik dengan Jawa Timur. Ada satu wisata pantai yang menarik di Sukabumi, yaitu Pantai Karang Hawu. Pantai Karang Hawu berada di Kecamatan Cisolok, Kabupaten Sukabumi, Propinsi Jawa Barat.

Objek wisata pantai ini dikenal dengan nuansa mistis yang berhubungan dengan mitos penguasa pantai selatan, Nyi Roro Kidul. Pantai ini merupakan salah satu pantai terkenal di Sukabumi dengan ciri khas tebing yang menjorok ke laut.

Pantai ini di sebut Karang Hawu, karena di areal pantai ini ada sebuah karang yang menjorok ke laut dan memiliki lubang di beberapa bagiannya yang berbentuk menyerupai tungku (atau hawu dalam bahasa sunda). Karena itu, pantai ini kemudian dinamakan Pantai Karang Hawu.

Harga tiket masuk Pantai Karang Hawu di Sukabumi yaitu Rp 2.500. Keistimewaan yang dimiliki oleh pantai ini ialah panorama alamnya yang sangat indah, udaranya sejuk, dan memiliki hamparan pasir yang lembut dan luas.

Warna pasir di pantai ini putih sedikit kecoklatan dengan teksturnya yang halus. Sementara garis pantainya memiliki panjang mencapai 3 km dengan tepian yang melengkung. Di pantai ini, Sahabat Sporto dapat melakukan aktivitas seperti surfing, berenang, dan memancing.

title: At least, KarangHawu is a better beach in PelabuhanRatu area
text:
PelabuhanRatu beach in my opinion is dirty and not to beautiful, but there's a better beach in PelabuhanRatu area that can be visited: KarangHawu beach.

We can still see trashes on KarangHawu beach but not as many as we can see on PelabuhanRatu beach. KarangHawu beach is quite beautiful, has a huge waves, and a nice place to be captured by camera.

There is a hill around Karang Hawu beach, local people said that Nyi Roro Kidul ever secluded her self and mediated in that hill. The first president of Indonesia, Sukarno, also mediated in the same hill. If we go up to the (small) hill we can see KarangHawu in aerial view. You can mediate in that hill too if you want too :)

Conclusion: KarangHawu is not a best beach, but KarangHawu is a better beach in PelabuhanRatu area at least.
